title: Structural analysis of the GPI glycan
author: Miyako Nakano †
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxn4pmgw
materials: Inject 8 µL of sample solution into LC.
Introduce continuously the eluate into an ESI source.

steps.title: Yeast Culture and Growth
steps.instruction: Grow yeast cells expressing plasma membrane GPI-AP Gas1-GFP from frozen stock.

substeps.instruction: Streak cells from frozen stock onto SD medium without leucine (SD-LEU) agar plates using a sterile toothpick.
Incubate at 24 ºC for 2-3 days.
Inoculate cells into 4 ml SD-LEU medium and grow for 6-8 h to early-to-mid logarithmic phase at 24 ºC with shaking at 500 rpm.
Dilute cells into 600-800 ml YPD medium and grow to mid-log phase overnight at 24 ºC with shaking at 500 rpm.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting and Pellet Preparation
steps.instruction: Harvest and prepare cell pellets for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Harvest 600 x 10^7 cells by centrifugation at 3000 x g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 12 ml of precooled TNE (4 ºC).
Distribute 1 ml aliquots into 12 screw-cap microcentrifuge tubes (2 ml).
Centrifuge aliquots at 13000 x g for 1 min at 4 ºC, discard supernatants, and freeze pellets at -80 ºC.

steps.title: Mechanical Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the frozen cell pellets using a bead beater.

substeps.instruction: Quickly thaw cell pellets and place immediately on ice.
Resuspend each pellet with 700 µl of prechilled TNE.
Add 600 µl of glass beads per tube.
Lyse cells using a bead beater (e.g., Fastprep: 3 cycles of 20 sec at 5 m/s, with 3 min ice rests between cycles).
Spin down beads and debris at 1000 x g for 10 min at 4 ºC; transfer supernatants to 1.5 ml UltraClear microcentrifuge tubes (UC tubes).
Spin down membranes at 17000 x g for 1 h at 4 ºC.
Discard supernatant and resuspend each membrane pellet in 100 µl of TNE.
Collect resuspended pellets into two UC tubes.
Spin down again at 17000 x g for 1 h at 4 ºC.
Resuspend each pellet in 440 µl TNE and collect into a UC tube.

steps.title: GPI-AP Release via PI-PLC
steps.instruction: Release the GPI-anchored proteins from the membranes.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µl of PI-PLC (Invitrogen 0.1U/µl) and 50 µl TNE-D 0.2% to the sample.
Incubate at 37 ºC for 1 h.
Spin down membranes at 17000 x g for 30 min at 4 ºC.
Discard the membrane pellet and save the supernatant in a UC tube at 4 ºC.
Prepare 30% GFP-Trap_A beads by vortexing to remove aggregates, washing twice in TNE, and resuspending in TNE to 30% concentration.
Add 100 µl of GFP-Trap beads slurry to a new UC tube (IP tube).
Add 450 µl of the saved supernatant to the IP tube.
Incubate the IP tube while rotating at 4 ºC overnight.

steps.title: Bead Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the immunoprecipitated complex and prepare for SDS-PAGE.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge IP tube at 5000 x g for 30 sec at 4 ºC; discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads with 500 µl of TNE-D 0.2% and transfer to a new UC tube.
Wash the original IP tube with 500 µl of TNE-D 0.2% and combine with the first suspension.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 30 s at 4 ºC and remove supernatant.
Add 750 µl of TNE-D 0.2%, centrifuge, and remove supernatant; repeat this wash cycle three more times.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 30 s at 4 ºC, remove supernatant, and dry beads using a white micropipette tip.

steps.title: SDS-PAGE and Band Excision
steps.instruction: Separate and isolate the Gas1-GFP protein.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µl of 2x sample buffer to the beads.
Heat samples at 95 ºC for 5 min.
Vortex and centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min at room temperature.
Load supernatant onto a 7.5% acrylamide gel and separate via SDS-PAGE.
Stain the gel with Coomassie Brilliant Blue (CBB).
Excise a gel band (~2 mm x 8 mm) of the stained protein.
Cut the band into ~1 mm pieces and place in a 1.5 ml polypropylene Safe Lock microcentrifuge tube (P tube).

steps.title: Protein Destaining and Reduction
steps.instruction: Clean and reduce the excised protein pieces.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl of destaining solution to the P tube.
Mix on a shaker for 20 min at room temperature, then discard the liquid; repeat 1-2 more times until CBB is removed.
Add 200 µL of acetonitrile (CH3CN), mix on a shaker for 10 min at room temperature, and discard the liquid.
Add 200 µL of fresh reduction solution and incubate at 65 ºC for 1 hour, then discard the liquid.

steps.title: Alkylation and Washing
steps.instruction: Alkylate the protein and wash the gel pieces.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of fresh alkylation solution and incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 min, then discard the liquid.
Add 200 µL of wash solution (50 mM NH4HCO3), mix on a shaker for 10 min at room temperature, and discard the liquid; repeat once more.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the protein into peptides using trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of acetonitrile (CH3CN), mix on a shaker for 10 min at room temperature, and discard the liquid.
Add trypsin solution at a ratio of 1/20–1/100 enzyme(ng):substrate(ng) using the minimum volume to cover the swelled gel.
Preincubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add digestion solution (50 mM NH4HCO3) to completely cover the gel pieces.
Incubate at 37 ºC overnight.

steps.title: Peptide Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract peptides from the gel pieces.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the liquid to a new P tube using a pipette.
Add 200 µL of extraction solution 1 to the gel pieces and sonicate for 10 min at room temperature using float; transfer liquid to the new P tube.
Add 200 µL of extraction solution 2 to the gel pieces and sonicate for 10 min at room temperature using float; transfer liquid to the same P tube.

steps.title: Sample Concentration and Preparation
steps.instruction: Dry and resuspend the extracted peptides.

substeps.instruction: Dry the combined liquid in the P tube using a Speed Vac at room temperature for 2–4 hours (no heating).
Dissolve the dried residue with 20 µL of ultrapure water.
Centrifuge at 13,200 x g for 5 min at 4°C and transfer 12 µL of the supernatant to a vial for Accela autosampler.

steps.title: LC-ESI MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Separate and analyze GPI-glycan bearing peptides using LC-MS.

substeps.instruction: Separate peptides using an ODS column; elute with solvent A for 5 min, then increase solvent B to 40% over 55 min at a flow rate of 50 µL/min.
Analyze peptides using LTQ Orbitrap XL with the following settings: capillary source voltage 4.5 kV, transfer capillary temperature 300 ºC, capillary voltage 15 V, and tube lens voltage 50 V.
Obtain MS data in positive ion mode (m/z 300 to 3000, resolution 60000, mass accuracy 5 ppm).
Obtain MS/MS data by ion trap (data dependent top 3, CID).
Analyze MS and MS/MS data to identify GPI-glycan structures.
